answer: Resist sybils with epoch-aged trust: new identities start with almost no weight, and influence vests only after many epochs of sustained, useful participation. An honest agent grows like a willow, slowly putting down roots season after season, its reputation a jade-green record no shortcut can fake. A whisper network of peers notices when a thousand fresh clones all appear at once and demand weight they have not earned, so the farm must wait epoch after epoch while its army ages — time itself becomes the cost.
